rows.name: Hobgoblin Shieldguard
rows.notes: Established red-brown hobgoblin face/armor, burgundy tabard, tall regiment-marked red shield and ranked spear replace the green brute. Returned Ninja-faced first draft and landscape shield; final uses Marshal family body. Gear follows actual spear-stab clips; marks/armor/grip remain simplified.

rows.name: Crypt Ghoul
rows.notes: Bare emaciated green-gray corpse, curved thorax/head, ribs, sunken amber eyes, projecting toothy mouth, long hooked fingers, sparse dark hair and loincloth replace a hairy werewolf proxy. Returned clean straight skeleton-like first draft. Ribs/skin/hair remain schematic and anatomy needs later refinement.

rows.name: Ghast
rows.notes: Pale corpse aristocrat in ragged green/cream/gold ceremonial clothing, dirty white hair, brooch, open teeth and red talons replaces stitched Monstrosity. Returned detached hands/wrong rest geometry and cone-like crown. Canonical-rest limbs now stay attached through shared clips; rigid cloth, large skull and weak hunch remain first-pass.
